name: media-tools
description: Audio and video work for every agent: convert, trim, join, compress, pull out the sound, make GIFs and thumbnails, burn in subtitles with ffmpeg, and download media you have the right to with yt-dlp.

commands.name: ffmpeg
commands.hint: On a Mac: brew install ffmpeg. On Ubuntu or Debian: sudo apt install ffmpeg. On Windows: winget install ffmpeg.
